description: NaGaN₃H₅NHH₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. The structure is one-dimensional and consists of four H₂ clusters; four NH clusters; and two NaGaN₃H₅ ribbons oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(1), np.int64(0)) direction. In each H₂ cluster, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one H atom. The H-H bond length is 0.75 Å. In each NH cluster, N is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one H atom. The N-H bond length is 1.06 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In each NaGaN₃H₅ ribbon, Na is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two N atoms. There is one shorter (2.28 Å) and one longer (2.37 Å) Na-N bond length. Ga is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three N atoms. There are a spread of Ga-N bond distances ranging from 1.81-2.27 Å. There are three inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Ga and three H atoms. All N-H bond lengths are 1.02 Å. In the second N site, N is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one H atom. The N-H bond length is 1.04 Å. In the third N site, N is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one H atom. The N-H bond length is 1.03 Å. There are five inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom.
